tensurafragments.skill.stripped: This power has been broken down into fragments
tensurafragments.skill.gambit_cards.desc: §oThrow cards that stick where they land. Warp to them, or blow them up — just not in your own face.
tensurafragments.skill.shikigami_control: §oPaper and a little magic. Breathe life into stone, fold paper into beasts and see through their eyes, bind a barrier, and let a paper doll take the blow meant for you.
tensurafragments.shikigami.bad_block: That block can't become a shikigami
tensurafragments.shikigami.barrier_needs: A barrier needs at least %s talismans
tensurafragments.shikigami.barrier_alrea: Your barrier is already up (sneak to dispel it)
tensurafragments.shikigami.too_many_anch: You can only place %s barrier talismans
tensurafragments.shikigami.barrier_colla: Your barrier collapsed: out of magicules
§oAn empty book that hungers. Weaken a creature and bind it with paper, catch a spell mid-flight, and call them back out when you need them.
tensurafragments.grimoire.created: Your book becomes a Sealing Grimoire
tensurafragments.grimoire.too_strong: Too strong to seal: weaken it to %s%% health first
tensurafragments.grimoire.faded: %s faded away: no room in the grimoire
tensurafragments.shikigami.substitution_: Substitution on: paper dolls will take hits for you
tensurafragments.skill.rainbow_talismans: §oTensura's spells and spirits, reborn in every colour at once. Each one burns, freezes, shocks and crushes in a single rainbow strike.
tensurafragments.skill.mode.rainbow_magi: Cast Rainbow Spell (sneak: switch spell, last is Rainbow Spirit)
tensurafragments.skill.flame_emperor.des: §oSovereign of every flame. Command all of Tensura's fire magic, and when that isn't enough, call down the Draconic Hell Storm.
death.attack.tensurafragments.draconic_i: %1$s was incinerated by Draconic Hell Storm
%1$s was incinerated by %2$s's Draconic Hell Storm
death.attack.tensurafragments.inferno_cu: %1$s burned away in Draconic Hellfire while fighting %2$s
tensurafragments.skill.mode.shikigami_co: Possess Beast: see through it / come back (sneak: unfold all)
tensurafragments.beast.none: You have no paper beast to see through
tensurafragments.beast.snapped_back: Your body was hurt: you snap back into it
tensurafragments.skill.spirit_control.de: §oEvery blow calls a spirit. Ifrit, Sylphide, Undine, the War Gnome and the Blade Tiger answer in turn, strike once, and are gone.
tensurafragments.skill.mode.spirit_contr: Call Spirit at your aim (sneak: Spirit Link on / off)
tensurafragments.spirit.link_on: Spirit Link on: your attacks call spirits
tensurafragments.spirit.link_off: Spirit Link off: only the skill key calls spirits
tensurafragments.skill.mode.rainbow_magi: Rainbow Spirit: summon the next spirit, in rainbow, at your aim
§oLittle magic of your own, but elf eyes that see the spirits of fire, wind, water and earth. Call them to your side and they will cast what you never could.
tensurafragments.skill.mode.spirit_commu: Call Spirit: bind the one you look at (sneak: all within 8 blocks)
Spirit Magic: release your spirits as one spell
tensurafragments.yifa.sight_on: Spirit Sight: you see the spirits around you
tensurafragments.yifa.need_sight: You can't see any spirits: turn on Spirit Sight
tensurafragments.yifa.full: You already have %s spirits with you
tensurafragments.yifa.no_bound: No spirits with you: call some first

item.tensurafragments.spirit_lantern.too: Carried: more spirits gather, and they come to wait at your side
tensurafragments.magic.surviving: Survived %s: %s/%s (live through it to learn it)
tensurafragments.magic.learned_by_surviv: You've survived %s enough to learn it!
tensurafragments.skill.energy_magic.desc: §oPour your life's experience into a spell. Tensura's magic, burning green with twice the power, paid for in levels instead of magicules.
tensurafragments.energy.no_levels: Not enough levels: this spell needs %s
tensurafragments.skill.soul_reaper.descr: §oEvery life you take leaves its soul in your hands. Call the dead back to fight for you, devour their power, or pour them into the living to make them yours.
tensurafragments.soul.none: You haven't captured any souls. Kill something first.
tensurafragments.soul.not_enough: Not enough souls: summoning this needs %s, you have %s
tensurafragments.soul.cant_summon: The soul of %s can't take form
tensurafragments.soul.absorbed: You devoured the soul of %s: +%s EP
tensurafragments.soul.no_target: Look at a creature to possess it
tensurafragments.soul.too_strong: %s (EP %s) is too strong for the soul of %s (EP %s)
